title: 甲状腺手術後 定期フォロー
description: 耳鼻咽喉科・頭頸部外科の定期再診で、甲状腺機能・超音波所見・チラーヂン補充量を評価するシナリオ。

tasks.title: 直近の甲状腺機能の確認
tasks.description: TSH, fT4, fT3 の推移を確認する。

tasks.title: 直近の超音波画像の確認
tasks.description: 残存甲状腺の形態変化を前回と比較する。

tasks.title: 精密検査(FNA,CTなど)の必要性の判断
tasks.description: 超音波所見のハイリスク所見有無から精査の要否を判断する。

tasks.title: チラーヂン補充量の確認
tasks.description: 外来処方におけるチラーヂン補充量の推移を確認する。

tasks.title: チラーヂン補充量の変更
tasks.description: 甲状腺機能と直近補充量から不足・過剰を判断する。

data_nodes.description: TSH, fT4, fT3 の直近12か月推移
data_nodes.sql: SELECT "報告日" AS "検査日", MAX(CASE WHEN "検査項目"='TSH' THEN "結果(数値)" END) AS "TSH", MAX(CASE WHEN "検査項目"='fT4' THEN "結果(数値)" END) AS "fT4", MAX(CASE WHEN "検査項目"='fT3' THEN "結果(数値)" END) AS "fT3" FROM "検体検査結果" WHERE "患者ID"='HASEBE_THYROID_001' AND "報告日">=date('now','-12 months') AND "検査項目" IN ('TSH','fT4','fT3') GROUP BY "報告日" ORDER BY "報告日"

data_nodes.description: 甲状腺超音波の直近2回比較
data_nodes.sql: WITH recent AS (SELECT "報告日", COALESCE("所見", '-') AS "所見", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "報告日" DESC) AS rn FROM "生理検査レポート" WHERE "患者ID"='HASEBE_THYROID_001' AND "レポート名" LIKE '%甲状腺超音波%' ) SELECT '### 超音波所見（直近比較）' || char(10) || '- 最新(' || COALESCE((SELECT "報告日" FROM recent WHERE rn=1), '-') || '): ' || COALESCE((SELECT "所見" FROM recent WHERE rn=1), '-') || char(10) || '- 前回(' || COALESCE((SELECT "報告日" FROM recent WHERE rn=2), '-') || '): ' || COALESCE((SELECT "所見" FROM recent WHERE rn=2), '-') AS "echo_compare_markdown"

data_nodes.description: 超音波所見に基づく精密検査要否
data_nodes.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT "報告日", COALESCE("所見", '') AS "所見" FROM "生理検査レポート" WHERE "患者ID"='HASEBE_THYROID_001' AND "レポート名" LIKE '%甲状腺超音波%' ORDER BY "報告日" DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT '### 精密検査要否の判断' || char(10) || '- 判定日: ' || COALESCE((SELECT "報告日" FROM latest), '-') || char(10) || '- 根拠所見: ' || COALESCE((SELECT "所見" FROM latest), '-') || char(10) || '- 判断: ' || CASE WHEN (SELECT "所見" FROM latest) LIKE '%微細石灰化%' OR (SELECT "所見" FROM latest) LIKE '%不整%' OR (SELECT "所見" FROM latest) LIKE '%高血流%' THEN 'ハイリスク所見あり。FNAまたはCT検討。' ELSE '明らかなハイリスク所見なし。定期フォロー継続。' END AS "decision_markdown"

data_nodes.description: チラーヂン補充量の直近12か月推移
data_nodes.sql: SELECT "服薬開始日" AS "処方日", CAST("一日量" AS REAL) AS "チラーヂン量(μg/日)" FROM "処方" WHERE "患者ID"='HASEBE_THYROID_001' AND "薬剤名" LIKE '%チラーヂン%' AND "服薬開始日">=date('now','-12 months') ORDER BY "服薬開始日"

data_nodes.description: 甲状腺機能と補充量に基づく投与調整判断
data_nodes.sql: WITH latest_labs AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "検査項目"='TSH' THEN "結果(数値)" END) AS tsh, MAX(CASE WHEN "検査項目"='fT4' THEN "結果(数値)" END) AS ft4, MAX(CASE WHEN "検査項目"='fT3' THEN "結果(数値)" END) AS ft3, "報告日" FROM "検体検査結果" WHERE "患者ID"='HASEBE_THYROID_001' AND "検査項目" IN ('TSH','fT4','fT3') GROUP BY "報告日" ORDER BY "報告日" DESC LIMIT 1), latest_dose AS (SELECT CAST("一日量" AS REAL) AS dose, "服薬開始日" FROM "処方" WHERE "患者ID"='HASEBE_THYROID_001' AND "薬剤名" LIKE '%チラーヂン%' ORDER BY "服薬開始日" DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT '### チラーヂン補充量変更の検討' || char(10) || '- 検査日: ' || COALESCE((SELECT "報告日" FROM latest_labs), '-') || char(10) || '- TSH: ' || COALESCE(CAST((SELECT tsh FROM latest_labs) AS TEXT), '-') || ', fT4: ' || COALESCE(CAST((SELECT ft4 FROM latest_labs) AS TEXT), '-') || ', fT3: ' || COALESCE(CAST((SELECT ft3 FROM latest_labs) AS TEXT), '-') || char(10) || '- 現在投与量: ' || COALESCE(CAST((SELECT dose FROM latest_dose) AS TEXT), '-') || ' μg/日' || char(10) || '- 判断: ' || CASE WHEN (SELECT tsh FROM latest_labs) > 4.5 THEN '補充不足の可能性。増量を検討。' WHEN (SELECT tsh FROM latest_labs) < 0.3 THEN '補充過剰の可能性。減量を検討。' ELSE '概ね目標範囲。現行量継続を基本に症状で微調整。' END AS "dose_adjust_markdown"

widget_nodes.title: チラーヂン投与量推移
